import re, subprocess, sys, yaml

clone, before, after = sys.argv[1:4]


def m(p, s):
    return re.fullmatch(".*".join(re.escape(x).replace(r"\*", "[^/]*") for x in p.split("**")), s) is not None


def assign(mp, paths):
    n = yaml.safe_load(open(mp))["namespaces"]
    return {s: tuple(k for k, v in n.items() if any(m(p, s) for p in v["paths"])) for s in paths}


paths = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", clone, "ls-files"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split("\n")
paths = [p for p in paths if p]
a, b = assign(before, paths), assign(after, paths)
changed = [s for s in paths if a[s] != b[s]]
bad_after = [s for s in paths if len(b[s]) != 1]
print("tracked", len(paths))
print("changed", len(changed), "all experiments/:", all(s.startswith("experiments/") for s in changed),
      "before none:", all(a[s] == () for s in changed), "after doc-records:", all(b[s] == ("doc-records",) for s in changed))
print("not exactly one after:", len(bad_after), bad_after[:5])
print("not exactly one before:", len([s for s in paths if len(a[s]) != 1]))
